summary: Oversized leaf, fails both leaf limits - same shape as the already-split WI-03b/WI-03c. Named changed subsystems count 4 against the 3-responsibility cap, and the body genuinely changes all four: simulation (speed-mismatch movement, no-combat-target status, fauna-announcement trigger, no-clean-view visibility), rendering (very-long spine extension plus foreground-occluder and parallax passes - new passes, not data-driven body shapes), world content data (CreatureDefs plus spawns and fixed-encounter placement in worldData.ts), tests (per-species scenarios plus two roster-wide final proofs). Independent behavior count is 6: (1) the 2-4 huge set-piece organisms with their signature rules, (2) the 2-3 colossal presences including the fauna-first-announcement and no-clean-view floors, (3) the section 52 simulation-side scale rules, (4) the section 52 renderer extensions, (5) tier-4 production placement, (6) the roster-wide final proofs (AC-roster-count world-data check and AC-roster-tests test-existence check plus spoiler audit of all ST-03 commits). Useful split boundary, per the WI-03c precedent: d1 = simulation behavior - CreatureDefs, tier-4 sim rules, per-species headless signature scenarios asserting fauna-announcement ordering and the no-clean-view window from sim visibility state; subsystems [creature simulation, world content data, headless scenario tests]; criteria AC-roster-large, AC-roster-tests. d2 (depends on d1) = section 52 rendering - spine extension, foreground occluder, parallax pass, no center framing, browser spot-checks of one large and one colossal; subsystems [procedural creature rendering]; criteria AC-roster-large, AC-roster-tests. d3 (depends on d1 and d2) = production and final proof - tier-4 spawns and encounter positions in the private bands, the whole-roster world-data count check as FINAL PROOF for AC-roster-count, the roster-wide test-existence check plus spoiler audit as FINAL PROOF for AC-roster-tests; subsystems [world content data, headless scenario tests]; criteria AC-roster-count, AC-roster-tests. Each child carries a strict subset of the parent's subsystems and criteria; the union covers all three parent criteria verbatim. Preserve full scope when splitting: every deliverable, test, constraint, and the section 46/11.2 gates move to the children; the fauna-announcement and no-clean-view floors stay AC-roster-large with named final proof owners in d1 (behavior, headless) and d2 (presentation).
